question:
Using Calculus, sketch on plain paper the graph of the function
\[
f(x)=x^2+x+\frac1x+\frac1{x^2}\quad\text{for }x\ne0.
\]
Show that the function \(f\) defined as above for positive real numbers attains a unique minimum. What is the minimum value of the function? What is the value of \(x\) at which the minimum is attained?
